body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below — every level a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance (caching, event-driven, zero idle cost); (3) **full vanilla parity on non-current maps** so mods touching those APIs "just work", as if one big map.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection, foreign types in method bodies only. ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. **See-below / cross-gap is ONLY sky<->surface**; basement is routing-only.
- Basement default is solid rock; **with Biomes! Caverns loaded it generates as a living cavern (2026-07-21)**.
- Stairwells do NOT exchange heat between levels (user directive, run-14).
- Sky-view mountain = ONE connected vanilla rock texture per stone type; native walls keep vanilla edge lips; fogged deep interior = vanilla fog. USER-VERIFIED run #17. **Better Mountains variant mode (2026-07-22) is the sanctioned exception: when BM swaps a rock to Graphic_Random, the cap fill mirrors BM's own lip-less painterly look.**
- **THE OUTERMOST RING OF ANY SKY MASS IS ALWAYS AB_MountainTop lip (KindLedge)** — meadows start 1 cell back exactly like ledges (run #43 regression, fixed).
- **MINED PEAK EXPOSES OPEN SKY**: gates are `level == 1`; with additional map levels they MUST become "topmost level of the column". Comments at both sites.
- **Pod transit handoff is LATE**: `HandoffTicksToImpact = 22`.
- **HEIGHT LANGUAGE (2026-07-22, user-driven)**: the sky slab must read as SITTING ON TOP of the surface, never the gap as a pit. Rules: vertical faces live on the SLAB's side of the rim line, ascending (vanilla mountain grammar); ground through gaps renders BRIGHT and PLUMB (no shift, no parallax, low dim); ground-side shading is a narrow one-sided contact shadow, NEVER a uniform dark ring; mountains keep their (vanilla or BM) wall language untouched. Save point tags: `pre-height-language`, `pre-compat-tranche` (git repo in mod folder).
- **ARCHITECTURE DECISION (2026-07-22)**: user floated single-map "mesa model" (plateau folded into surface map, native combat). Rejected after trade-off review — it amputates under-mountain interiors, mineable-peak reveal, and sky building over open ground. Stacked maps stay; the see-below view already renders the REAL lower map live. If mesa-lite ever returns, it is a separate scenario option, not a rework.

## HEIGHT-LANGUAGE REWORK (2026-07-22) — BUILT, awaiting first in-game run
Three mockup rounds (mockups/: depth_*, elev_*, stack_*, height_*, stackwalls_*) converged on: face-on-slab-ascending = height, face-in-gap-descending = pit. User picked height_1/2 + stackwalls_1 (plumb rim walls; base-course sliver deferred, wall drape covers v1).
### Removed
belowParallax + strength; belowDepthShift south shift (below view now PLUMB; ScreenToBelowPos = identity passthrough kept as the single inversion point; ApplyDrawShift = y only); descending skirt south faces; descending wall-facade sliver (SectionLayer_ABWallFacade.Visible => false, body preserved as Regenerate_Retired for clip-machinery reference).
### Added
- **SectionLayer_ABRimFacade** (sky map): ascending facade band on the southern strip of every slab rim cell with air directly south — dark contact line (10%) -> gradient body -> lit top corner (12%). Height = `rimFacadeHeight` (0.25-1.0 c, default 0.55, live via AB_BelowThings dirty). Tint: supporting below-wall DrawColor > sky terrain def color > neutral grey. Vertex colors on white VertexColor mat in the cap layer's queue window +1. Exclusions: cap + mined rock floors (atlas lip owns those), edifice-on-rim (sprite+drape is the face), reveal-covered cells.
- **Skirt rework** (vertex-colored): narrow one-sided contact shadow (0.28 c, alpha 96->0) from north rims only; E/W hairlines; bright lip line where slab sits SOUTH of air. skirtMat = white VertexColor at ceiling-60.
- belowDim default 0.12 -> 0.06 (scribe key belowDimLight -> belowDimHeight).
### Watch on first run
Facade tint over colored floors; reveal-vs-facade handoff at fog edges; bright lip at night under mask dim; rimFacadeHeight live slider.
### Deferred
Base-course sliver (needs over-cutout queue experiment); two-storey shifted rim walls (stackwalls_2 opt-in); translucent built floors / build-mode below ghost; military projection (mocked height_3, rejected for parity risk).

## COMPAT TRANCHE (2026-07-22) — BUILT, awaiting first in-game run
1. **Sky biome inheritance** (`skyBiomeInherit`, default ON): GenStep_ABSkyTerrain swaps the pocket map's deep-scribed PrimaryBiome from AB_OpenSky to the surface map's biome at creation (cavern mechanism). Regrowth, wild plants, trees, weather follow the surface. Creation-time only — existing saves keep their birth biome; toggle off restores AB_OpenSky for new levels. AB_OpenSky def stays (legacy + toggle).
2. **Medieval Overhaul rock formations** (generalizes to ALL multi-cell below things): below-things printer anchors multi-cell prints on the FIRST occupied cell that is open air on the sky level, not the root cell — 2x2 formations hugging a mountain edge no longer vanish from the sky view. NOTE: MO formations are mineable/impassable but NOT QualifiesAsSupport (mineable excluded), so reveal/facade were never affected.
3. **Better Mountains variant mode** (cap layer): BM replaces rock graphics with Graphic_Random (painterly 2x2 variants, NO linked atlas) at startup AND on BM settings changes. Cap layer now: detects non-linked rock graphic -> emits one deterministic variant sprite per mass cell (StableCellIndex hash, centered, graphic's own drawSize so neighbors overlap into BM's composed rockfield), skips link masks + corner fillers; unknown custom graphic classes get a flat MatSingle fill. Both material caches (atlas + variants) validated against the LIVE graphic reference so BM settings changes never serve stale looks. Meadow fade skirts unchanged. BM first-run config auto-selects Tanyfilina packs, so an isolated test session exercises variant mode out of the box.

## PARITY TRANCHE — COMPLETE (runs #1-#15) — all USER-VERIFIED
Cross-level combat, ritual attendance, wild-animal wandering, universal targeting hub, sky-view mountain rendering. Pod transit + AA interception USER-VERIFIED run #39.

## 2026-07-21 FEATURE TRANCHE (runs #40-#47)
### 1. Destination-aware stair routing (Movement/StairRouter.cs) — BUILT, self-test in place
Whole-trip scoring (pawn->stairs + climb-as-cells + exit->dest) with pawn-less PassDoors dest-side filter, never bricks. Consumers keep one virtual scan then Reroute by discovered destination. Wired: work/needs/joy/rest/food migration, medical + prisoner transport, haul verdict cache (stores cell), fetch giver, right-click orders (click cell), attack chase, ritual gather, caravan gather (meetingPoint FieldRefAccess). Deliberately not: hostiles, idle-return, go-up/down gizmo, animal wander. API dest overloads. Dev: `AB: stair-routing self-test`.
### 2. Biomes! Caverns basements — WORKING runs #41-#47
GenStep_ABCavernCarve (order 210): connected worm network + chambers, openness slider; biome swap via deep-scribed `map.pocketTileInfo.PrimaryBiome`; weighted random (Fungal 50/Crystal 35/Earthen 15 — **Earthen is 55C**, `constantOutdoorTemperature` beats pocket temp) or fixed dropdown. Biome-authentic floors, auto rock pillars, BC scatterers by defName, initial flora/fauna. KNOWN-BENIGN: "Scatterer ... could not find cell" ~1x/gen. Dev: `AB: cavern-basement self-test`.
### 3. Naturalistic mountain peaks — VISUALS ITERATED THROUGH run #47 (user: "this is great" x2)
ONE meadow field (Perlin 0.024, cutoff 0.60) decides rock vs open; lip ring locked; enclosed meadows refogged = hidden valleys. Plateau: rough stone/gravel/soil (arable slider), surface-biome flora (vegetation slider, no cave plants), outcrop mounts; AB_OpenSky biome wildPlants (DICTIONARY form — run-40 lesson) — superseded by biome inheritance for new maps when the toggle is on. Fade skirt: vertex-alpha strips 0.8 c into meadow, near alpha 150 (run-46 tuning). Dev: `AB: peak-plateau self-test`.
### 4. Camera level lock (QoL): KeyBindingDef `AB_CameraLevelLock` (default End); suppresses automatic level switches; manual always works; `cameraLockKeybind` setting.
### Fixes landed: run-40 wildPlants li-record format; run-41 sky auto-roof guard NRE on detached regions.

### Settings
naturalPeaks + peakSoilFraction + peakVegetation; skyBiomeInherit; cavernBasements + cavernBiome + cavernOpenness (BC-gated); cameraLockKeybind; belowDim (0.06), drawSlabEdge, drawWallReveal + wallRevealWidth, drawWallFacade (rim facades) + rimFacadeHeight, belowThingScale. Scroll view.

### Roadmap
Ongoing: vanilla-API parity audit. Deferred: cell-targeted ability casts, beam turrets, scribed turret orders, multi-select formations, cross-level prisoner/animal ritual participation, T9 soak, T5 publishing. Watch: stalagmite density polish, cavern steady-state fauna respawn.

## Dev-tools ("As above")
ensure sky+basement; cross-gap combat / auto-engage / targeting-hub / animal-wander / ritual-attendance / mech-overseer / bond+home / pod-transit / stair-routing / cavern-basement / peak-plateau self-tests; below-view diagnostic; probe ledge cell (T:); toggle cap corner fillers.

## Prior verified features (unchanged)
Select pawns/items in place; bidirectional right-click orders + Reverse Commands; merged colonist bar; stairs/elevators; cross-level power/pipes; work/haul/supply/needs/medical/prisoners; see-below renderer; opt-in threats; world integration; modder API.

## Compat
DBH water riser, VEF generic duct, Rimefeller chem riser, VCHE chemfuel riser. Biomes! Caverns cavern basements (soft, defName-only). Better Mountains variant-mode rock rendering (soft, graphic-type detection). Medieval Overhaul rock formations in below view (generic multi-cell anchor fix). Anti-air interception (verified #39). INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded. CE out of explicit scope.

## Status
2026-07-22: Height-language rework + compat tranche (biome inherit, MO formations, BM variant mode) built and committed. Next: one combined verification run (companions: Better Mountains + Medieval Overhaul) covering rim facades/contact shadow/lips, BM rockfield rendering, biome-inherited plateau flora, and an MO formation at a mountain edge; then older outstanding items, soak, publishing prep.
